description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI`, which validates URIs according to RFC 3986 within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for creating URI instances, validating URIs with scheme-specific rules, and managing URI filtering logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI
classes.description: A class responsible for validating and processing URI attributes in HTML documents, ensuring they conform to RFC 3986 and library-specific rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URI parser and sets whether the URI embeds resources.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new URI object, possibly marked as embedded based on the input string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a URI string using configuration and context objects, applying generic and scheme-specific validation and filtering.
